description: An event-based gateway before one message and one timer is one AWA wait whose timeout takes the timer's path. A message start event names the business event that starts a run.
bpmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:awa="https://awa.io/schema/interchange/1.1" id="Definitions_ebg" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn">
<bpmn:message id="Msg_order" name="order.placed"/>
<bpmn:message id="Msg_pay" name="payment.received"/>
<bpmn:process id="P" name="Payment">
<bpmn:startEvent id="S" name="Order placed"><bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_1" messageRef="Msg_order"/></bpmn:startEvent>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_req" name="Request payment"/>
<bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EBG"/>
<bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_pay" name="Payment received"><bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_2" messageRef="Msg_pay"/></bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
<bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_to" name="Two days"><bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_1"><bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P2D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition></bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_ship" name="Ship"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_cancel" name="Cancel order"/>
<bpmn:endEvent id="E1"/>
<bpmn:endEvent id="E2"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="S" targetRef="T_req"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="T_req" targetRef="EBG"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="EBG" targetRef="C_pay"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="EBG" targetRef="C_to"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="C_pay" targetRef="T_ship"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="C_to" targetRef="T_cancel"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="T_ship" targetRef="E1"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="T_cancel" targetRef="E2"/>
</bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
